key_case_law.significance: PAS / Eltern-Kind-Entfremdung als 'wissenschaftlich überholt und widerlegt' eingestuft; nur Gesamtwürdigung mit Kindeswohl-Orientierung verfassungskonform.
PAS als 'pseudowissenschaftliche Hypothese'; Mindestanforderungen an Sachverständigen-Gutachten (multimodaler Ansatz, keine einseitige Auswahl der Gesprächspartner).

structural_finding: Germany 2023-26 has crossed an institutional inflection point. The BVerfG 17.11.2023 — 1 BvR 1076/23 ruling, combined with the DJI-aligned Zimmermann/Fichtner/Walper/Lux/Kindler (2023) ZKJ critique and the OLG Frankfurt 7 UF 88/25 (2026) Sachverständigen-Mindestanforderungen, has moved the critique camp from minority position to institutional mainstream, leaving the recognition camp's older anchors (Boch-Galhau, Kodjoe, Andritzky, Jopt) without an institutional university-clinic base, and the contemporary anchor (Rücker) operating from a private GmbH rather than a verified university chair. The German PA-clinical scene is therefore structurally inverted compared with most other PASG-active jurisdictions: the recognition camp is counter-mainstream, the critique camp is institutional core.
major_corrections: Jörg Fichtner is critique camp, not recognition camp — frequently miscategorised because of his forensic family-court Sachverständigen practice.
Stefan Rücker is not a Universitätsprofessor at Bremen — Universität Bremen Senat (2024) explicitly disputed the institutional framing of 'PETRA Arbeitsgruppe an der Universität Bremen'.
Cochem-Zell no longer practices the Cochemer Modell — model was discontinued at the Cochem Familiengericht after Rudolph's 2008 retirement.
'BAG-EUK' as a federal working group — named in activist literature but not verifiable as a current Vereinsregister-listed PA-focused body.

No individual German forensic Sachverständige is repeatedly positively-named in post-2023 OLG PA case-law — the case-law trend is the systematic criticism of Gutachter-qualifications in PA-framed custody-transfer recommendations.
